doc:
The family in the signed covariance identity is computed from the
current cycle, including its actual particular increment and signed curl.
name: NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleParameters.signedFamily

signature.text:
{ι : Type} →
  (p : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleParameters ι) →
    (v : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleCoefficients ι) →
      (c : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.Context NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) →
        (u : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.State NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) →
          (primary : ι → NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) →
            (P : ι → ℕ → NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint → ℝ) →
              {σ κ : ℝ} →
                1 / 5 ≤ σ →
                  (N : ℕ) →
                    (∀ (l : ι), (primary l).BandLimited N) →
                      NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CoefficientBands v →
                        (∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier (v.blocks l) (primary l)) →
                          (∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier (v.blocks l) (p.signedBlock v c u l)) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2)
                                  fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
                                  ((v.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j x) →
                              (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                  NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (17 / 25)
                                    fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
                                    ((v.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j x - ((primary l).velocity n i).coeff j x) →
                                (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                    NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2 + σ)
                                      fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
                                      ((p.particularBlock v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x) →
                                  (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                      NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2 + σ - κ)
                                        fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
                                        ((p.signedTangent v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x) →
                                    (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 + σ - 2 * κ)
                                          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
                                          ((p.signedCurl v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x) →
                                      (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ p.strip.domain, 0 ≤ P l n x) →
                                        (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ p.strip.domain, P l n x ≤ 1) →
                                          (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), (v.blocks l).angularFrequency n ≠ 0) →
                                            NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.SignedFamily p.strip P (1 / 2) (17 / 25)
                                              (1 / 2 + σ - κ) (1 + σ - 2 * κ)

value.text:
fun {ι : Type} (p : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleParameters ι) (v : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleCoefficients ι)
    (c : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.Context NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint)
    (u : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.State NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint)
    (primary : ι → NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint)
    (P : ι → ℕ → NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint → ℝ) {σ κ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 / 5 ≤ σ) (N : ℕ)
    (hprimary : ∀ (l : ι), (primary l).BandLimited N) (hband : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CoefficientBands v)
    (hcp : ∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier (v.blocks l) (primary l))
    (hcs : ∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier (v.blocks l) (p.signedBlock v c u l))
    (hold :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2)
          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) => ((v.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j x)
    (hdiff :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (17 / 25)
          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
          ((v.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j x - ((primary l).velocity n i).coeff j x)
    (hpart :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2 + σ)
          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
          ((p.particularBlock v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x)
    (htangent :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 / 2 + σ - κ)
          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
          ((p.signedTangent v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x)
    (hcurl :
      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass p.strip P (1 + σ - 2 * κ)
          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint) =>
          ((p.signedCurl v c u l).velocity n i).coeff j x)
    (hP0 : ∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ p.strip.domain, 0 ≤ P l n x)
    (hP1 : ∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ p.strip.domain, P l n x ≤ 1)
    (hkp : ∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), (v.blocks l).angularFrequency n ≠ 0) =>
  { primary := primary, old := p.beforeSignedBlock v c u, tangent := p.signedTangent v c u, curl := p.signedCurl v c u,
    bandwidth := max (max N v.residualBand) 1, primary_band := ⋯, old_band := ⋯, tangent_band := ⋯, curl_band := ⋯,
    primary_carrier := ⋯, tangent_carrier := ⋯, curl_carrier := ⋯, old_bounds := ⋯, difference_bounds := ⋯,
    tangent_bounds := htangent, curl_bounds := hcurl, envelope_nonneg := hP0, envelope_le_one := hP1,
    angular_ne_zero := hkp }
